## Context / Problem
These 18 `tests/unit` modules contain 163 audited prose blocks: 96 leading docstrings and 67 full-line comment regions (10,800 before-words), frozen at `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. The old vague numeric ranges mixed prose with executable code. The exact census below replaces them and protects concise blocks. The merged `run_security_detectors` → `run_detectors` edit is executable and out of scope.

## Approach
Freeze the 163-block manifest from the base before editing. `D:<owner>` is a leading `Expr(Constant(str))`; `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal consecutive full-line COMMENT-token region owned by the innermost AST scope and anchored to the next unchanged code. Compact `D{a,b}` / `C{scope@anchor,...}` expands under the row path; TSV IDs are full `<path>#<ID>`. Threshold rules use `len(docstring.split())` and `len(region.replace("#"," ").split())` on the base only.

Retain base/final blobs and parse each with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On copies remove only allowlisted leading docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and compare `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)`. Tokenization rejects changed inline or non-allowlisted comments. Runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, data, shebangs, and directive-bearing physical lines stay exact; only adjacent blank lines may normalize.

## Exact stable block allowlist
- Four one-block files: `tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py`, `tests/unit/test_reconciler_shadow_package_ordering.py`, `tests/unit/test_referencing_commits_alias_scan_perf.py`, and `tests/unit/test_registry_version_rotation.py` each own `D:<module>`.
- `tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` (3): `D:test_pin_regex_rejects_sha_where_legacy_token_extractor_would_wrongly_pass`; `C{<module>@def test_13b4_provenance_runbook_uses_the_pypi_verifier,<module>@RECONCILE_BRIDGE}`.
- `tests/unit/test_relocated_store_repo_root.py` (20): every D with >=31 base words and every C with >=30 base words or a physical `---`/`===`/`──`, except `D:test_ensure_fresh_local_read_context_skips_root_resolution` and `C:_init_relocated_store@assert not (external.parent / "rebar.toml").exists()`.
- `tests/unit/test_repo_isolation_guard.py` (4): `D{<module>,_blocking_git,test_a_transient_probe_stall_is_re_sampled_rather_than_reported}`; `C{<module>@def _root_conftest}`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_finding_publish.py` (5): `D:<module>` plus its four ornamental C regions anchored to `test_pass_message_enumerates_advisory_finding_text`, `test_block_message_enumerates_both_blocking_and_advisory_findings`, `@pytest.mark.parametrize`, and `class _FakeGerrit`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_in_flight.py` (4): `D{<module>,test_health_endpoint_reports_the_queue_depth,test_health_exposes_in_flight_without_needing_the_reviewbot_extra,test_the_reconciler_path_is_counted_too}`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_retrigger_attestation_6a81.py` (11): `D{<module>,_trailer_ticket,test_a_multi_finding_block_is_REFUSED_even_when_only_the_attestation_line_renders,test_a_flagged_attestation_is_REFUSED_and_the_reply_NAMES_the_verdict,test_an_infra_verdict_does_not_accept_and_the_reply_NAMES_the_verdict,_raw_finding_message,test_a_MISSING_HEADER_refuses,test_an_UNPARSEABLE_COUNT_refuses,test_a_MISSING_CRITERION_LINE_refuses,test_the_ticket_id_comes_from_the_commit_TRAILER_not_the_finding_text}`; `C{<module>@def _raw_finding_message}`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_retrigger.py` (2): `D:<module>`; `C{<module>@_G2P_INI}`. `tests/unit/test_review_bot_stale_vote_baa8.py` and `tests/unit/test_review_bot_token_redaction.py` each own `D:<module>`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py` (93): every D with >=31 base words and every C with >=30 base words or a physical `---`/`===`/`──`. This exact rule protects the short local contracts while retaining all long history/explanation and ornamental headings.
- `tests/unit/test_review_discovery_architecture.py`: `D:<module>`. `tests/unit/test_review_discovery_executor.py` (4): `D:<module>` plus the three ornamental C regions anchored to `_unit`, `test_all_success_stage_reports_every_unit_success_with_aggregated_usage`, and `test_local_failure_preserves_earlier_successes_and_skips_dependents`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_discovery_shadow.py` (9): `D:<module>` plus all eight ornamental C regions, anchored to `_unit`, `test_matching_projections_report_ok_with_no_mismatches`, two regions before `test_allowlist_names_exactly_the_six_approved_deltas` (suffix IDs `:held-out-banner` / `:ac1-banner`), `test_dropping_a_non_disabled_builtin_is_not_an_approved_delta`, `_observed_no_overlay`, `test_a_legacy_checkpoint_envelope_never_changes_the_comparison`, and `test_compare_discovery_is_deterministic`.
- `tests/unit/test_review_flags.py`: `D:<module>`.

## Protected false positives
Every unlisted block is protected, including concise translated-shape/forged-attestation docstrings and per-case executor/shadow rationale. Preserve all E402/noqa/type-ignore/pragma lines and each full-line `# timing: hang-guard` directive at its statement attachment; preserve argv, Terraform/YAML snippets, regexes, payloads, and detector names exactly.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
Keep canary classification, shadow imports, one-pass aliases, registry rotation, release pins, relocated-root and isolation behavior, review-bot finding/retrigger/in-flight/revision/token/shutdown/cursor/scratch protocols, discovery boundaries, and edit/claim review flags. Focused consumers are `test_scripts_import_convention.py`, `test_release_guards.py`, `test_repo_isolation_deadline_heldout.py`, and `tests/unit/review_bot/test_rp04_s5_decision_auth_heldout.py` (imports the review-bot test harness). No target docstring consumer was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The frozen manifest resolves to exactly 163 unique path-qualified IDs: 96 D and 67 C.
- [ ] Only blocks resolved from the frozen manifest change.
- [ ] Adjacent blank-line changes occur only next to an edited block.
- [ ] Base and final normalized ASTs match on every owned path.
- [ ] Token comparison finds no changed inline or non-allowlisted comment.
- [ ] Runtime strings remain byte-identical.
- [ ] Directive-bearing physical lines remain byte-identical.
- [ ] A non-author reviewer posts exactly 163 leaf-linked TSV rows with these columns: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Every TSV row has `after_words < before_words`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `directives_exact=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `semantic-preservation=PASS`.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] Before citations use `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84:<path>#<stable-id>`.
- [ ] Final citations use `<final-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.

## Verification
Five DD commands run owned tests plus consumers, scoped Ruff check/format, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`.
